Package com.nexuslink.protocol.kafka

Class SchemaRegistryClient

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.kafka.SchemaRegistryClient
public final class SchemaRegistryClient extends Object
A small client for a Confluent-style Schema Registry REST API (list subjects/versions, fetch a schema by subject+version or by id, and register a new schema version). Transport is the JDK HttpClient; responses are parsed by the dependency-free SchemaRegistryJson, so the module needs no JSON library. Optional HTTP basic auth is supported.
